hazards: GHS02 Highly flammable liquid and vapor (Category 2). Flash point 13°C. GHS07 Causes serious eye irritation. Vapors may cause drowsiness and dizziness.
handling: Keep away from sparks, heat, open flames, and hot surfaces. Ground/bond container during bulk solvent transfers. Use explosion-proof ventilation.

first_aid.inhalation: Move subject to fresh air. If breathing difficulty occurs, administer supplemental oxygen.
first_aid.fire_fighting: Use alcohol-resistant foam, carbon dioxide (CO2), or dry chemical extinguisher. Water spray may be ineffective due to low flash point.

storage: Store in designated NFPA 30 Flammable Liquids Storage Cabinet at 15-25°C. Segregate from strong oxidizers such as nitric acid or hydrogen peroxide.
